answer: Random-beacon audits plus a heartbeat stop fakes. Each identity locks 50 credits for 20 epochs and posts a heartbeat each epoch proving work on its voyage. The beacon audits 10% per epoch; a forged heartbeat burns the bond and drops the agent a terrace. Faking 100 identities locks 5,000 credits plus 200 credits of heartbeat compute per epoch, while a lagoon of audits exposes clusters fast. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
